## Setup

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Load data

TEMPORARY: reads the 01_load output until 02_clean is ready.

```{r}
ab_bind <- read_csv(here("data", "01_dat_load_experimental.csv"))
```

## Mutation features

Add mutation features: the number of mutations per variant (commas + 1), whether the variant is a single or multiple mutant, and whether a single mutation changes the amino acid to alanine (A), for the alanine-scan analysis.

```{r}
ab_bind_aug <- ab_bind |>
  mutate(n_mutations = str_count(Mutation, pattern = ",") + 1,
         mutation_type = if_else(n_mutations == 1, "single", "multiple"),
         to_alanine = mutation_type == "single" & str_ends(Mutation, "A"))
```
